batches.effect: Opening Manage inflates the row from 62px to 460px, re-flows every column (live: Email x 550->506), moves that row's trigger ~147px left, leaves the menu static with no overlay shadow; live it ignores Escape and two menus stay open together (page grows to 1308px).
batches.fix: Make the row-actions menu an anchored overlay (out of flow, --ky-shadow-overlay, one open at a time, Escape/outside click close and return focus to the trigger) so row height and column widths never change; on phones let it span the full record width or open as a sheet. Keep UserRowActions' per-row authorization rendering, delete separation and operation-bound step-up unchanged.

batches.effect: Empty lists are a header-only table card, a dashed rule, a floating 'No matching…' message and a disabled pager; App connections has no primary and its button touches the title (0px gap live); on phones its table scrolls inside the card (576px in 348px) hiding Actions; Applications' empty message names App connections without a link.
batches.fix: Use one page-header pattern (h1 left, the view's single primary right, same height/icon as Users' Create User); when total is 0 render a real empty state (what belongs here + the existing create/manage action) and hide the table header and pager; say 'No groups yet' unless a search is active; stack App connections rows on phones like Users; compress the policy paragraphs to one quiet line. No new features: link only to existing views/actions.

batches.surfaces: security (4), phone shell on all 28 signed-in phone captures, users mobile (2)
batches.effect: Native checkbox renders Chromium blue (live accent-color: auto); secondary buttons are 31-34px; every Security section is its own card with dashed inner rules and inconsistent header wrapping at 390px; phone nav is two unlabelled scrolling rows and Applications repeats the signed-in identity; Users phone records have no heading.
batches.fix: Set accent-color to the accent token on checkboxes/radios, bring buttons to --ky-control-size, flatten Security sections to divided rows like KyRecovery with one header layout; give the two phone nav groups their visible group labels (or one row with a divider) and drop the duplicate 'Signed in as' line; make the account name the heading of each Users phone record.

Status pill and pager text use mono where it is not fixed-width data.
